summary: @koutropoulos This is the big takeaway post for from #OpenEd19 and #OpenConPhilly19, brewing in my head, and I don't want to be too forceful but want to say, "Are you doing this with your own data, no? Then stop talking and start doing."
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @koutropoulos This is the big takeaway post for from #OpenEd19 and #OpenConPhilly19, brewing in my head, and I don't want to be too forceful but want to say, "Are you doing this with your own data, no? Then stop talking and start doing."
